# google_design_center_catalog_template

A Design Center Catalog Template.




## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the catalog template.

* `space` -
  (Required)
  The space of the catalog template.

* `catalog` -
  (Required)
  The catalog of the catalog template.

* `catalog_template_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the catalog template.

* `template_category` -
  (Required)
  The category of the template.
  Possible values are: `APPLICATION_TEMPLATE`, `COMPONENT_TEMPLATE`.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  The display name of the catalog template.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  The description of the catalog template.

* `type` -
  (Optional)
  The type of the catalog template.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/catalogs/{{catalog}}/templates/{{catalog_template_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the catalog template.

* `uuid` -
  The unique system-generated UUID for the template.

* `latest_revision_id` -
  The ID of the latest revision of the template.

* `create_time` -
  The time the catalog template was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time the catalog template was last updated.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.

- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


CatalogTemplate can be imported using any of these accepted formats:
